profile.headline: Embedded Firmware System Engineer
profile.summary:
Embedded software/firmware engineer with extensive background in full software lifecycle: specification, design, implementation, integration, debug, and maintenance. Excellent in low-level real time operation system debugging and trouble-shooting hardware at the device level. Recognized as a strong team player with a terrific work ethic who facilitates success, commitment, and inspires teamwork. Bicultural, U.S. citizen.

Specialties: RTOS: X2, VxWork,ThreadX,RTXC,CMX
C/C++/Assembly 
Device drivers.
Board Bring up.
DxDesigner,
PADS,
FPGA Schematic Designs,
VHDL,
ISE,
ModelSim,
Aldec
Timing Designer,

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Supported development team to expedite releasing the enhanced flow computer, the largest independent manufacturer of custody transfer flow computers and the industry leader in oil and gas measurement solutions.
* Implemented and successfully released SD card features, works included implementing driver, securing the records with SHA1 cryptographic for storing and retrieving. Optimizing the file structure and accessing steps to maximize data access time with low priority tasks in the MQX RTOS running on MPC 68 Processor.
* Enhanced refactor Common Batch Stack for ease of use and simplified accessing MODBUS registers.
* Lead the implementation of a liquid GC feature, followed an API specification. Required to add/change calculation algorithm, and customized template reports. Successfully released the feature on time.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Improved and enhanced their medicine dispensing product by adding a new fully automated unit-dose feature, designed to increase accuracy and efficiency of medicine given out in nursing facilities.
* Strengthened main controller firmware, bringing the system to a robust and reliable level to deploy serval units to customer sites.
* Redesigned the main controller board with DSPIC33FJ256 CPU replacing the obsolete MC68331. Works including: evaluating and selecting hardware components, drawing schematic, testing prototype, porting code from RTXC to new FreeRTOS. 
* Eliminated cost of wasted pills and field service trips through process of reproducing, fixing, testing and releasing firmware for any dropped meds issues that were found from monitoring customer reports daily.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to implemented drilling look-ahead features, which is a part of directional drilling products and services for gas and oil.
RTOS, Firmware, Embedded Software:
* Enhanced firmware  using C++. Work included: modifying interrupt service, generating messages and testing routine for FPGA changes.  90 % of the work was completed a month early.
* Collaborated with hardware engineers to generate design-verify-test code for new release of FPGA, decreasing the risk of timing, clock and temperature issues to 0.1%.
* Developed diagnostic manufactured testing software for on board memories and com ports.

positions.title: Sr Engineer
positions.description:
Network Solutions Company with Access and Core products

• Developed and released the application level and driver software for the optical card (STM1/OC3- PMC Spectra andTemux28) using C/C++, including diagnostic functions for engineer’s debug application.
• Developed and released firmware, software application and driver for the T1/E1 line card. The Mother board used the Motorola Communication processor 68360 part of DNX1U (Base Station Access Product) using C/C++ along with Rhapsody for APS (Auto Protection Switching).
• Implemented and released DHCP server into Multiprotocol Router (SpanNet) along with improved features and fixed bugs such as PPP, Multi –PPP, RIP, and OSPF. Beat the deadline by two weeks to facilitate a customer deal with a tight schedule. 
• Brought up, released and sustained optical card (STM1/OC3) in DNX system (Narrowband DACS – digital cross connect) using: schematic capture PADS; HyperLynx for PCB ; VHDL, ModelSim and Aldec for Xilinx FPGA. Effort included redesign of card level schematic and modification of FPGA (Virtex-E XCV300E & Spartan XC3S1500) VHDL code for product enhancement.
• Generated VHDL test bench for router card FPGA using ALDEC Design Verification tool.
• Generated self-checking VHDL test bench for DS3 card FPGA (Spartan XC3S2000) using Modelsim Design Verification tool.
• Redesigned and released Sync E3 and Router rear card.
• Implemented and released 19.2K over 56 K for High Speed Data card (Nx56K/64K) using Xilinx FPGA –VHDL combined with software skills to complete the project quickly and with reliable operation.
• Troubleshot, debugged and solved several critical issues in the following areas: Ethernet, TDM bus, HDLC protocol, T1/E1, E3, DS3, and STM1/OC3 (SDH/SONET).

positions.title: Sr Firmware/Hardware  Engineer
positions.description:
Public Safety Switch and PSAP (dispatch console) product development for controlling base station radio equipment:

Senior Design Engineer
• RTOS, Firmware, Embedded Software:
• Developed and released firmware, software to enerate/detect audio control tones on the Motorola 68340 processor using Assembly, C, and C++.  Tone processing occurred every 125us in an interrupt handler in which the code must be implemented in Assembly for maximum performance. 
• Developed and released diagnostic firmware, software for the TDM-150 and T-5 - the dispatcher console - using C/C++. 
• Developed and released software for Multi Telephone Line card (MLC) using C/C++.
• Developed and released software for Modem Interface card using assembly and C.
• Developed and released software for front end of 2-way Radio Base station interface card (LIC).
• Designed and released Multi Telephone Line card (MLC) that contains four telephone lines to interface between central office and 911- telephone trunking. Involved both digital and analog circuitry that included creation of two-wire echo cancellation using MathCAD and Orcad for schematic capture.
• Designed and released digital audio mixer circuitry using Xilinx FPGA 2000 family to replace the analog solution. Implemented 9bit A to D and 14bit D to A with firmware involved. Used Future Net schematic and Xilinx XACT tool with 92 % used logic in FPGA. Hand routed several nets to complete the routine.
• Designed and released for Modem Interface cards (RIA remote interface adapter) with 9600, 19.2K and 38.4K baud rate, using Z180 and 80c31 processor. 
• Designed & developed Power supply Supervisor card to monitor voltage and current status as well as providing battery charger and tester functionality. 
• Designed & released an 80C31 micro-controller board to adjust stepper motors based on level sensor feedback for a motorized dispatch console desk.
